data.name: Penultimate Incantation
data.description: 3/day, you can affect a single creature within 60 ft. with a targeted greater dispel magic. Each spell or effect dispelled inflicts fire damage to the target equal to the result of your caster level check made to dispel that effect. This ability is the equivalent of a 9th-level spell.
